cases.sentence: И Исаак пошёл к ___, царю филистимлян, в Герар.
cases.translation: And Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, in Gerar.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative → Авимелеху.

cases.sentence: В земле был ___, не тот прежний голод, который был при Аврааме.
cases.translation: There was a famine in the land, not the earlier famine that was in Abraham's days.
cases.explain: Голод is the subject of был (there was) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: …я исполню клятву, которую дал твоему ___ Аврааму.
cases.translation: …I will fulfill the oath which I swore to your father Abraham.
cases.explain: Отец is the recipient of дал (gave/swore to) — the indirect object → dative.

cases.sentence: Я сделаю твоё потомство многочисленным, как звёзды на ___.
cases.translation: I will make your offspring numerous, like the stars in the sky.
cases.explain: На marking a static location (in the sky) takes the prepositional → небе.

cases.sentence: Исаак засеял ___ в той земле и собрал урожай стократно.
cases.translation: Isaac sowed the fields in that land and reaped a hundredfold.
cases.explain: Поля is the direct object of засеял (sowed) → accusative (plural, same form as nominative for neuter).

cases.translation: They filled all the wells with earth.
cases.explain: The means with which they filled the wells is expressed by the instrumental → землёй.

cases.sentence: Исаак ушёл оттуда, поселился в Герарской ___.
cases.translation: Isaac left there and settled in the valley of Gerar.
cases.explain: В marking a static location (in the valley) takes the prepositional → долине.

cases.sentence: Авимелех пришёл к нему из ___ вместе с Ахузатом.
cases.translation: Abimelech came to him from Gerar together with Ahuzzath.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of/from) governs the genitive → Герара.

reading.ru: И Исаак пошел к Авимелеху, царю филистимлян, в Герар.
reading.question: To whom did Isaac go in Gerar?
reading.explain: Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, in Gerar.

reading.question: Where did Isaac settle?
reading.explain: The text says Isaac settled in Gerar.

reading.ru: Исаак засеял поля в той земле и в тот же год собрал урожай стократно, и Господь благословил его.
reading.question: How large a harvest did Isaac reap that year?
reading.explain: Isaac sowed and reaped a hundredfold in the same year, and the Lord blessed him.

reading.ru: Он назвал колодец Есек, потому что они спорили с ним.
reading.question: Why did Isaac name the well Esek?
options: Because they quarreled with him over it
reading.correct: Because they quarreled with him over it
reading.explain: He called the well Esek because the herdsmen quarreled with him over it.

reading.ru: Исаак построил там жертвенник и призвал имя Господа и поставил там шатер, а слуги его выкопали колодец.
reading.question: What did Isaac build at Beersheba?
reading.explain: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord.

reading.ru: Когда Исаву было сорок лет, он женился на Иегудифе, дочери Хетта Беэра, и на Босимате, дочери Хетта Илона, и от них было много огорчения Исааку и Ревеке.
reading.question: How old was Esau when he married Hittite wives?
reading.explain: When Esau was forty years old he married Judith and Basemath, and they grieved Isaac and Rebekah.
